parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of setting a header to None in a session, but it may introduce unintended behavior.

issues.description: The patch removes headers with None values from the session, which may break existing behavior for users who rely on headers being set to None.
The patch does not include tests to verify that headers with None values are correctly removed from the session.
